articles.headline: World Cup Daily live: Neymar on as Brazil dominate Scotland; Morocco lead Haiti
articles.description: We are now down to the final round of group stage matches at the 2026 FIFA World Cup, where all teams from the same group will be playing at the same time.

articles.headline: Socceroos vs. Paraguay: Australia ready for World Cup 'fight'
articles.description: The stakes will be high in Group D's finale between Paraguay and Australia. Win or draw and the knockouts await, but lose? Well that could spell disaster.

articles.headline: Lionel Messi gets World Cup birthday treat with Argentina squad
articles.description: Lionel Messi celebrated his 39th birthday on Wednesday during a World Cup that, at least for now, has brought him nothing but joy.

articles.headline: Canada remain a work in progress as the World Cup knockouts loom
articles.description: Canada's sobering loss to Switzerland meant they lost a golden opportunity to play a round-of-32 game in front of their home fans.
